create_attentive_pooler: create an AttentivePooler module with learnable query tokens and cross-attention to pool sequence embeddings
create_attentive_classifier: create an AttentiveClassifier that pools sequence embeddings then classifies into num_classes categories
build_pooler_with_depth: build an AttentivePooler with multiple self-attention blocks by setting depth greater than one
review_cross_attention_block: review the AttentivePooler cross-attention block configuration with configurable num_heads and mlp_ratio
test_init_weights: test the AttentivePooler weight initialization using trunc_normal_ and rescaled block scaling
